name: mizan-pos-desktop
description: Secure Electron shell for Mizan POS
author: Mizan POS

scripts.test:standalone: npm run build && npm run prepare:standalone && node scripts/test-standalone-runtime.cjs
scripts.package:dir: node scripts/ensure-native-runtimes.cjs && npm run validate:runtimes && npm run build:renderer && npm run build && npm run prepare:standalone && npm run test:installer && electron-builder --dir
scripts.package:mac: npm run ensure:runtimes:mac && node scripts/validate-native-runtimes.cjs darwin-arm64 darwin-x64 && npm run build:renderer && npm run build && npm run prepare:standalone && npm run test:installer && electron-builder --mac dmg --publish never
scripts.package:mac:all: npm run ensure:runtimes:mac && node scripts/validate-native-runtimes.cjs darwin-arm64 darwin-x64 && npm run build:renderer && npm run build && npm run prepare:standalone && npm run test:installer && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:win: npm run ensure:runtimes:win && node scripts/validate-native-runtimes.cjs windows-x64 && npm run build:renderer && npm run build && npm run prepare:standalone && npm run test:installer && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.release:mac: node scripts/validate-release-env.cjs mac && npm run ensure:runtimes:mac && node scripts/validate-native-runtimes.cjs darwin-arm64 darwin-x64 && npm run build:renderer && npm run build && npm run prepare:standalone && npm run test:installer && electron-builder --config electron-builder.release.cjs --mac --arm64 --x64 --publish never
scripts.release:win: node scripts/validate-release-env.cjs win && npm run ensure:runtimes:win && node scripts/validate-native-runtimes.cjs windows-x64 && npm run build:renderer && npm run build && npm run prepare:standalone && npm run test:installer && electron-builder --config electron-builder.release.cjs --win --x64 --publish never
